{"command": "$rev = @(1000,2000,3000,4000,5000,6000)

}", "description": "内存计算六个月收入成本利润"}

  [pscustomobject]@{month='1月'; rev=1000; cost=700},
  [pscustomobject]@{month='2月'; rev=2000; cost=1400},
  [pscustomobject]@{month='3月'; rev=3000; cost=2100},
  [pscustomobject]@{month='4月'; rev=4000; cost=2800},

  [pscustomobject]@{month='6月'; rev=6000; cost=4200}

$trev = ($months | Measure-Object rev -Sum).Sum
$tcost = ($months | Measure-Object cost -Sum).Sum

"TOTAL=$trev COST=$tcost PROFIT=$profit MARGIN=$margin%"
", "description": "Compute totals in memory"}
